name: B&M market canopies and pavement stalls
observations: Two green/teal pitched canopy tents stand against brick frontage.
Fruit/vegetable tables/crates and temporary merchandise occupy footway under tents.
Thin canopy legs, fabric roof and tables are independent props; no permanent brick extension shown.
Cars and delivery vans partly overlap tents and stall edges.
For Zombies layout, reserve a clear route and make clutter placement an explicit gameplay decision, not an inferred venue wall.
unknowns: Exact dimensions, rear elevation and interior layout are not established. Street View address is a camera label, not this unit address.
review_basis: All listed captures reviewed in contact sheets; selected originals also inspected at native resolution. Notes describe visible appearance, not surveyed construction.
placement_confidence: Approximate frontage marker derived from camera route, side and estimated offset; not a measured footprint.
